lambda_x0.33.condition: Refit with the smoothing parameter multiplied by 0.33 (lambda=0.1547).
lambda_x0.33.interpretation: Maximum zero-rate change versus the selected curve is 0.19bp (mean 0.03bp, forward up to 3.41bp): negligible (below typical quote noise). In-sample RMSE over usable instruments under this condition: 0.32bp.

lambda_x3.00.condition: Refit with the smoothing parameter multiplied by 3.00 (lambda=1.392).
lambda_x3.00.interpretation: Maximum zero-rate change versus the selected curve is 0.21bp (mean 0.05bp, forward up to 4.70bp): negligible (below typical quote noise). In-sample RMSE over usable instruments under this condition: 0.33bp.

penalty_power_0.condition: Refit with the maturity-weight exponent of the roughness penalty set to 0 instead of the CV-selected 1 (same lambda).
penalty_power_0.interpretation: Maximum zero-rate change versus the selected curve is 0.21bp (mean 0.03bp, forward up to 3.89bp): negligible (below typical quote noise). In-sample RMSE over usable instruments under this condition: 0.31bp.

stub_rule_forward.condition: Rebuild every OIS/bond schedule with the 'forward' stub rule instead of 'contract_v2' and refit (same lambda).
stub_rule_forward.interpretation: Maximum zero-rate change versus the selected curve is 9.66bp (mean 1.30bp, forward up to 59.21bp): material - this factor moves the curve beyond quote noise and is listed under Limitations. In-sample RMSE over usable instruments under this condition: 3.19bp. The public conventions do not pin the payment dates or stub accrual of non-integer tenors; this reading is reported as an alternative interpretation, not as an error of the data.

stub_rule_forward_actual.condition: Rebuild every OIS/bond schedule with the 'forward_actual' stub rule instead of 'contract_v2' and refit (same lambda).
stub_rule_forward_actual.interpretation: Maximum zero-rate change versus the selected curve is 0.31bp (mean 0.02bp, forward up to 1.40bp): negligible (below typical quote noise). In-sample RMSE over usable instruments under this condition: 0.33bp. The public conventions do not pin the payment dates or stub accrual of non-integer tenors; this reading is reported as an alternative interpretation, not as an error of the data.

rates_only.condition: Refit using deposits and OIS only; bonds are then priced off the rates-only curve.
rates_only.interpretation: Maximum zero-rate change versus the selected curve is 0.50bp (mean 0.11bp, forward up to 6.48bp): negligible (below typical quote noise).

uniform_weights.condition: Refit with every quote given the same base scale (spread and liquidity information ignored; robust reweighting still active).
uniform_weights.interpretation: Maximum zero-rate change versus the selected curve is 0.25bp (mean 0.03bp, forward up to 3.16bp): negligible (below typical quote noise). In-sample RMSE over usable instruments under this condition: 0.31bp.

quote_shift_+1bp.condition: Shift every market quote by +1bp (bond prices by minus one basis point of yield) and refit; a well-behaved estimator moves the zero curve by about +1bp everywhere.
quote_shift_+1bp.interpretation: A +1bp parallel shift of every quote moves zero rates by 1.000bp on average (range 0.970 to 1.013bp); the maximum deviation from the expected 1bp is 0.030bp, so the estimator passes level shifts through linearly.

jackknife_tenor_clusters.condition: Leave one tenor cluster out at a time (robust weights fixed) and measure the largest change in the zero curve; large values flag tenors that single-handedly shape the curve.
jackknife_tenor_clusters.interpretation: Deleting one tenor cluster at a time changes the zero curve by at most 0.65bp; the most influential cluster is the 0.09y cluster. Influence is concentrated where the curve is least covered.

quote_noise_bootstrap.condition: 20 seeded replications adding Gaussian noise of one estimated noise scale to every quote (robust weights fixed); reports the standard deviation of the fitted zero curve.
quote_noise_bootstrap.interpretation: Across 20 bid/ask-scaled noise replications the zero-rate standard deviation is at most 1.01bp (median 0.41bp): quote noise of the observed size does not destabilise the curve.
